title: Extra shift or helping your brother move
prompt:
Your manager has just asked you to work an extra shift this Saturday. Two warehouse workers are sick, and a large shipment is arriving that day. However, a month ago you promised your brother that you would help him move into his new apartment on Saturday. He has already rented a truck, and he is counting on you.

Choose ONE of the following options:

Option A: Talk to your manager. Explain why you cannot work on Saturday, and suggest another way you could help.

Option B: Talk to your brother. Explain why you need to work on Saturday, and suggest how you can still help him with his move.
structure: Polite opener + show you understand the other person's problem
Explain your situation honestly with a specific reason
modelAnswer:
Hi Karen, do you have a minute? It's about the Saturday shift. I completely understand that we're short-staffed and that this shipment is a big one, so I really wish I could say yes. The problem is, I promised my brother a month ago that I'd help him move this Saturday. He's already rented a truck, and honestly, I'm the only person he has to help him.

But I don't want to leave the team in a difficult position, so here's what I can do. I could come in a couple of hours early on Friday and get the receiving area ready so the crew can unload faster on Saturday. I could also stay late on Monday to finish any put-away that's left. And if you'd like, I'll call Minh. I know he's been looking for extra hours.

I'm sorry I can't be there on Saturday itself, but I hope one of these options helps.

usefulExpressions.usageVi: Cách mở đầu lịch sự khi muốn nói chuyện với cấp trên.
Thể hiện bạn hiểu vấn đề của người kia trước khi từ chối.
Chuyển sang giải thích khó khăn của bạn một cách tự nhiên.

usefulExpressions.expression: I don't want to leave the team in a difficult position, so here's what I can do.
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Câu chuyển rất hiệu quả từ lời từ chối sang giải pháp.
Dùng 'could' để đưa ra phương án một cách mềm mỏng, để người kia lựa chọn.

commonMistakes: Nói về cả hai người hoặc nói với giám khảo ('I would choose option A because…'). Hãy chọn một người và nói trực tiếp với họ ngay từ câu đầu.
Từ chối quá thẳng ('I can't work Saturday. Sorry.'). Ở S6, giọng lịch sự và có giải pháp thay thế là yếu tố quyết định điểm.
Thiếu giải pháp cụ thể. 'I will try to help' quá chung chung — hãy nói rõ thời gian và việc bạn sẽ làm.

review.notes: Independent review: Clarified ambiguous 'come in early on Friday, maybe at five' -> 'a couple of hours early on Friday'. Direct address to manager, 3 concrete alternatives, length (~153) checked.
